hooks.text: The first confirmed black hole shoots jets at half light speed.
Cygnus X-1 is actively tearing gas from a massive star.
Twin plasma jets from a black hole shine with 10,000 suns.

title: The First Black Hole Shoots Dancing Jets
description: Cygnus X-1 was the first black hole confirmed by science, and it is currently tearing a blue supergiant apart at half light speed.

beats.text: The first confirmed black hole shoots jets at half light speed.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of Cygnus X-1 binary system, NASA illustration, 2011

beats.text: Discovered in 1964 during a sounding rocket flight, Cygnus X-1 sits 7,000 light-years away.
beats.visual: Aerobee sounding rocket launch at White Sands missile range, 1960s

beats.text: This heavyweight is locked in a tight celestial tango with a massive blue supergiant star.
beats.visual: Illustration of a black hole orbiting a massive blue supergiant star, NASA
queries: black hole binary system artist concept

beats.text: They orbit every 5.6 days at just one-fifth the distance between the Earth and sun.
beats.visual: Diagram showing the orbital separation of Cygnus X-1 and its companion

beats.text: The black hole continuously rips material from its companion, forming a disk that blazes in X-rays.
beats.visual: X-ray data visualization of Cygnus X-1 accretion disk, Chandra X-ray Observatory

beats.text: But the record-breaking surprise is the twin plasma jets blasting from the center.
beats.visual: Artist impression of relativistic jets emerging from a stellar-mass black hole

beats.text: These blazing jets shine with the energy of 10,000 suns while visibly dancing across space.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope view of relativistic jet features in a binary system

beats.text: Stellar winds from the supergiant make these beams visibly wobble as they race away.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of the Cygnus X-1 black hole system with jets, NASA

better_than_last: This episode fixes the previous dangling ending by ensuring the final beat is a complete, grammatical sentence that seamlessly loops back to the high-urgency contradiction hook.
